excerpt.zh: 看来[marauder_country_1.GetName]已在此恒星系建立了一处哨站。我们应该在他们站稳脚跟前将其铲除。
excerpt.en: It seems that the [marauder_country_1.GetName] have set up an outpost in this system. We should knock it out before they get a foothold.
